Peter,

When I decided to run for office, I knew I would be attacked. Unfortunately, that's politics these days.

I knew the Left would try to paint me as a man unfit to serve in public office. After all, I struggled with mental health issues when my professional football career ended. But I sought treatment, got help, and then spent the next decade encouraging others to get help if they needed it. In fact, I even wrote a book about my journey, _Breaking Free: My Life with Dissociated Identity Disorder_ , with the goal of helping others.

This summer, Raphael Warnock and Chuck Schumer's Super PAC spent more than $50 million attacking my character, my family, and my mental health struggles.

**But their ads didn't work.** The personal attacks against me failed to move the needle, so Raphael Warnock and I are neck-and-neck in the polls in the Georgia Senate race.

In their desperation to find something to distract the voters from real issues and blunt our momentum, they came up with an "October Surprise" alleging that I paid for a woman to have an abortion.

**Let me be clear: I have never paid for anyone to have an abortion. It's a flat-out lie.**

We cannot let the Left win by lying, cheating, or buying their way to victory. We need to stand together to fight back with the truth.

**[Peter, today I need your assistance more than ever before in this campaign. I need the resources to talk directly to the voters and clear the record.](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=10484786baf3486db0e5aacc6d712676&_e=cX_W3TP3B5o3QjLxrWSYRGzoExoJuyN1rj7q-03hYGKlwIWycuXPKV_DDqs8vTEgySYqWXlVyJUnPEk5lBOE1xEHpzdFwq7r6ilEnsY85nHSt4T05l-ktzdmIzKBrf6UQwZKKgZLKLrw8Ju0_EiPnw6VX1RZa3oVJ3ZvK9uoLG7UeL4RkI8vxC9tewI5pCPfwYFahCrH-UKxtjdz6nhoJcblDPAZrbuVKPHKM60mMWEl7p6pxQk-4aX8Y_dIo7dhFGq9PQ1WVE_Ihjg2kVI_on0G6KjavLWrURJk0LFtCowGyk8__3ChpkWq9fXfXC_OBCjZjyJpLCur8QjPV4xn446-VPaBmoEU5mreVuaSb2irB4vi3q13LV0EHJe67W1MngK0pOK00abDGf5itfqakA%3D%3D) **

Undecided voters are watching this race closely, and the Left knows it. That's why, 35 days before the election, they decided to distract from the real issues by telling a lie about me.

First, the Left used these tactics against Justice Clarence Thomas in an unsuccessful effort to keep him off the Supreme Court.

Then, 27 years later, they did the same thing to Justice Brett Kavanaugh as they tried to destroy him, his reputation, and his family.

Their intimidation tactics didn't work on Justices Thomas or Kavanaugh, and they're not going to work on me. Right now, all they've done is energize me more.

clean_body: The Left is desperate to distract the voters from real issues and blunt our momentum, so they came up with an “October Surprise.” We cannot let the Le | Peter, When I decided to run for office, I knew I would be attacked. Unfortunately, that's politics these days. I knew the Left would try to paint me as a man unfit to serve in public office. After all, I struggled with mental health issues when my professional football career ended. But I sought treatment, got help, and then spent the next decade encouraging others to get help if they needed it. In fact, I even wrote a book about my journey, Breaking Free: My Life with Dissociated Identity Disorder , with the goal of helping others. This summer, Raphael Warnock and Chuck Schumer's Super PAC spent more than $50 million attacking my character, my family, and my mental health struggles. But their ads didn't work. The personal attacks against me failed to move the needle, so Raphael Warnock and I are neck-and-neck in the polls in the Georgia Senate race. In their desperation to find something to distract the voters from real issues and blunt our momentum, they came up with an "October Surprise" alleging that I paid for a woman to have an abortion. Let me be clear: I have never paid for anyone to have an abortion. It's a flat-out lie. We cannot let the Left win by lying, cheating, or buying their way to victory. We need to stand together to fight back with the truth. Undecided voters are watching this race closely, and the Left knows it. That's why, 35 days before the election, they decided to distract from the real issues by telling a lie about me. First, the Left used these tactics against Justice Clarence Thomas in an unsuccessful effort to keep him off the Supreme Court. Then, 27 years later, they did the same thing to Justice Brett Kavanaugh as they tried to destroy him, his reputation, and his family. Their intimidation tactics didn't work on Justices Thomas or Kavanaugh, and they're not going to work on me. Right now, all they've done is energize me more. The Left is desperate to win this Senate race because they want to change this country, but we're not going to let it happen. Thanks, Herschel Walker | | PAID FOR BY TEAM HERSCHEL, INC. Friends, Election Day is less than a month away and momentum is definitely on our side. [_Georgia Gov. Brian Kemp (R) holds the lead in his reelection bid over Democratic challenger Stacey Abrams, new polling shows. __An InsiderAdvantage-Fox 5 poll released Thursday put Kemp 5 points ahead of Abrams among likely voters, 50 percent to 45 percent, with 3 percent undecided._](https://sable.madmimi.com/c/434664?id=1851330.505.1.da3940c7a1e63c73478146f64e967d38) While encouraged by the progress, there's more work to be done in the days ahead to Stop Stacey. That's why we need you now more than ever. You see, our resources are drying up. Folks think we have this race in the bag and that Stacey Abrams' candidacy is DOA. **Well, think again!** We know that Abrams has all sorts of tricks up her sleeves...and the media is always ready to spread her lies and misinformation. We have to stay focused and stay vigilant or the Governor's Mansion is going to have a new occupant. [Our humble request today is simple: Donate $100 before Midnight.](https://sable.madmimi.com/c/434664?id=1851330.506.1.c044ada8ff51f2fc7600b2ff3117a864) We know that [$100](https://sable.madmimi.com/c/434664?id=1851330.507.1.2604326bc3ac8fcd5024c3c5a0b5713f) is a lot of money, especially with Joe Biden's record inflation and rising energy costs but... Consider your secure contribution as an investment into Georgia's future. By stopping Stacey on November 8th, we can stop tax hikes and crippling regulations. If we end Stacey's political career next month, we can end another threat to democracy and the American way. So [chip in $100](https://sable.madmimi.com/c/434664?id=1851330.508.1.84565e756d1ca5f8edf105d3793ce248) before Midnight and let's #StopStacey before it's too late. For Freedom, Stop Stacey, Inc.

name: Harmeet Dhillon
subject: You can't be trusted..
body:
| | | Peter, Imagine that you've just been called into the middle school principal's office to have a "serious talk" about your daughter. You're worried -- is it her grades? Her behavior? Is she hurt? Instead, the principal tells you that your daughter -- your 12- year-old little girl -- is now your son. That behind your back, the school has been "educating" your preteen daughter \-- for months, in total secret -- about how to "transition" her gender. And they instructed her to keep it hidden from you...because you "can't be trusted." That you, her parent, are not "safe." But now, she has a new name. New pronouns. A new bathroom. And you just need to accept it. _Wouldn 't you be furious?_ I know I would be! So it's no surprise that's exactly how Jessica Konen felt when she was called into her daughter's California middle school and this nightmare played out in real life. **Now, Jessica is fighting back and suing the school district -- plus the principal and the two teachers who "groomed" her daughter -- and she needs your help to win justice in a court of law. ** [**Will you please make an urgent, tax-deductible donation to the Center for American Liberty and help us fund this lawsuit while generating a nationwide wave of support for Jessica and her daughter?**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61563075:JIdSeeVIN:m:1:3317145305:321A8938F7D88BF775BCFCEEAFEA1DE0:r) I hope you will, because as infuriating as that story is, the details are even more outrageous. Would you believe Jessica's daughter was just eleven when she was lured by these teachers to join their so-called "Equality Club"? **_They first convinced this little girl that she was bisexual. Then, as they sunk their hooks deeper, they told her -- not long after her twelfth birthday -- that really, she was probably "transgender." _** "But don't tell your parents!" they warned. In fact, they operated the entire club under a cloak of secrecy. No permission slips were signed. No attendance was taken. No membership lists were kept. Meetings were scheduled for lunchtime -- instead of after school, like other clubs -- so parents wouldn't begin to wonder where their kids were. What were they hiding?? If you've followed the growing nationwide problem of teachers "grooming" young, confused students -- you probably know some of the predatory tactics these teachers often use to manipulate vulnerable children into believing they're "transgender" or "non-binary." This case was no exception. In fact, these two teachers even let some of their secrets slip on leaked audio from a Teachers Association conference! Discussing how they managed to target so many new recruits for their club, one of the teachers confessed: "We totally stalked what they were doing on Google." **These teachers zeroed in on confused and troubled students and -- instead of helping them -- they further filled these children 's heads with lies and more confusion. ** [**Which is why I 'm asking you to make an urgent donation of $35 or more today if you agree with our lawsuit against these teachers, the principal, and the Spreckels Union School District.**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61563075:JIdSeeVIN:m:1:3317145305:321A8938F7D88BF775BCFCEEAFEA1DE0:r) My name is Harmeet Dhillon. I'm a lawyer, and the founder of the Center for American Liberty. You may recognize me from one of my many Fox News appearances with Jessica Konen or other plaintiffs my nonprofit organization is representing in lawsuits against government officials who violate Americans' rights. Today, I'm asking you to join us in support of Jessica's case. It's clear that the defendants deprived Jessica Konen of her civil rights as a parent, that they conspired to do so, and that they inflicted emotional distress on both Jessica and her daughter. Those legal claims and more are at the heart of our lawsuit. I believe our evidence lays out a very strong case. But you must remember, this is a California school district and the defense's case will be funded by the government. And it will pay whatever it takes to defend leftist ideologies. [**That 's why, I hope you'll also consider making a generous donation of $25, $35, $50 or $100 to help fund our case. **](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61563075:JIdSeeVIN:m:1:3317145305:321A8938F7D88BF775BCFCEEAFEA1DE0:r) The Center for American Liberty is a nonprofit organization, meaning we receive no government funding -- _unlike the deep-pocketed defendants in most of our cases._ Because of this, we rely on support from generous Americans who can recognize an injustice and want to see it set right. Our nonprofit status also means your donation is tax-deductible to the fullest extent allowed by law. We've seen evidence of this type of "grooming" at schools across the country. And it's not just in places like California! Dangerous teachers like this are unfortunately in classrooms across the country. Thankfully, the tide seems to be turning against them. Earlier this year, Governor DeSantis outlawed teachers from having these sexualized conversations with their young students. And elsewhere, parents have gotten involved with their local school boards to run for office and change policies that have put radical gender ideology ahead of student safety or parental rights. Those are political solutions. **Ours is a legal one.** And I believe that, in order to fully purge this predatory behavior from our schools, we need to fight this battle on all available fronts. Won't you please help us win this fight in a court of law?**[Join the fight with a generous donation of $35 or more so the courts, the plaintiffs, the defendants -- everybody -- will know how big the nationwide movement to protect kids has grown. ](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61563075:JIdSeeVIN:m:1:3317145305:321A8938F7D88BF775BCFCEEAFEA1DE0:r)** ** ** No parent should have to endure what Jessica Konen and her daughter did, and it's up to us to use the full force of the law to make sure no teacher is allowed to get away with this again. Thank you,
---

---
|
---
| | P.S. Winning this case will not only get justice for the Konen family, but also strike a blow against these dangerous school policies nationwide. **[Which is why I hope we can count on your generous tax-deductible donation of $25, $35, $50 or more to help us win this lawsuit and others like it. Thank you!](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61563075:JIdSeeVIN:m:1:3317145305:321A8938F7D88BF775BCFCEEAFEA1DE0:r) **

This is the most important election in our history. Failure is not an option.
This is Republican Whip Steve Scalise.
I wrote to you right after the Democrats won the special election in Alaska... Now I have **FAR WORSE** news to report.
The Hill laid out **SEVEN** House races that could determine who controls the Majority -- and we're in serious danger of losing. Why? Because Republicans nationwide are **BEHIND** in the generic ballot and **BEHIND** in the fundraising race!
[**I 'm rushing to you now because this is our last chance to turn the tide and I don't want Republicans to lose! We urgently need your help. **](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z9omh8lbp89f59k4n3v7qbqqha632gnkn8g8jg98_rp22sh2s8i66or5cpg69or6c1h2bs)

\-- Marc Molinaro (NY-19)

\-- Steve Chabot (OH-01)

\-- Jen Kiggans (VA-02)

\-- Matt Larkin (WA-08)
Now that we're just a few weeks out, we're officially in the **FINAL PHASE** of this election.

subject: This is my story, Peter.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Laxalt for Senate
body:
| |
---
| | | Peter, my name is Adam Laxalt. You may have never heard of me, so I wanted to take a moment to tell you a bit about why I'm running for U.S. Senate in Nevada.

I was born in Reno, Nevada and raised by a single mother. Growing up, it was just me and my mom. I have always aspired to be as much of a leader as she was.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61563095:JkBq4eVeN:m:1:3317145305:B2C1983409E96F10E922156A04A8A3DA:r "Adam 1")
---

I know that real leadership means standing up for what you believe in and standing up for people everywhere. But I was headed down the wrong path in life.

As a teenager, I suffered from addiction. But the people who loved me got me help. I turned my life around, and that taught me helping others gives life meaning. That's why I volunteered to serve in the Navy after 9/11 and volunteered to serve in the Iraq War.

---
| | | [SUPPORT ADAM LAXALT](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61563095:JkBq4eVeN:m:1:3317145305:B2C1983409E96F10E922156A04A8A3DA:r "SUPPORT ADAM LAXALT")
---

Serving our country as a Navy Officer in Iraq was an honor.

While I was serving, my unit was in charge of over 20,000 detainees to keep American troops safe. This was one of the most challenging experiences of my life, but also the most rewarding.

_Knowing that I was on the front lines of protecting the country I love so dearly is something that I will continue to cherish for the rest of my life. _

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61563095:JkBq4eVeN:m:1:3317145305:B2C1983409E96F10E922156A04A8A3DA:r "Adam 2")
---

After returning from Iraq, I felt the call to serve my state again and went on to be Nevada's Attorney General and top law enforcement officer. I fought hard to serve the people of Nevada, where I fought against President Obama by suing over federal overreach. I fought for the Constitution.

Now I'm taking on a huge challenge for our country: running for U.S. Senate.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61563095:JkBq4eVeN:m:1:3317145305:B2C1983409E96F10E922156A04A8A3DA:r "Adam 3")
---

My race is **officially the #1 race in the country** , and all eyes are on me. The Democrats have already raised 76 MILLION to destroy my campaign.

Unlike my opponent, I rely on grassroots supporters like you to keep my campaign running.

I know I will be great leader for the people of Nevada, and for the people of America.

Now that you know my story, _**[will you please chip in to help me continue it into the halls of the United States Capitol?](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61563095:JkBq4eVeN:m:1:3317145305:B2C1983409E96F10E922156A04A8A3DA:r "will you please chip in to help me continue it into the halls of the United States Capitol?")**_

---

Sincerely,
Adam Laxalt
_Republican candidate for U.S. Senate in Nevada_

| | | | | _Peter,_ I’m Paul Begala. I’m a Democratic campaign strategist, former counselor to President Bill Clinton, and I’ve dedicated my career to electing Democrats up and down the ballot.

So today, I’m reaching out about one of the most important races this cycle: **We have the incredible opportunity to unseat one of the worst Republicans in the US House, Rep. Chabot, and replace him with a champion for families.**

Our slim House majority is on the line in just a few weeks, and I know Greg Landsman is the leader we need to retire Chabot and protect our democracy, fundamental rights, and so much more.

**[Will you join me in supporting Greg Landsman’s people-powered campaign for this Ohio toss-up seat by chipping in $3 today? We need all hands on deck to get this done »](https://default.salsalabs.org/T611b1c5f-df43-4c65-8689-895cbfd79965/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)**

It’s imperative that we elect strong Democrats like Greg Landsman this year.

**Far-right Republicans, just like his opponent Chabot, want nothing more than to win the House majority and impose their extreme views on all of us.**

_They’ve made it clear:_ They want a national ban on abortion. They want to stack the Supreme Court with even more extremists. And they want to tear down the fundamental core of our democracy.

We can’t get complacent, Leslie. We’ve fought for too hard and for too long to let that happen.

| | Dear Friend of Liberty, Michael and Chantell Sackett have been fighting for 15 years to build a home on the private property they own near Priest Lake in Bonner County, Idaho. It’s not for the usual reasons like a lack of building supplies or unresponsive contractors. It’s because the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) declared that their land is a wetland. But here’s the kicker. The Sacketts’ land is not wet. There’s no water on it! Still, the government is going after them. And if the couple doesn’t comply with the EPA’s outlandish regulations, they could face fines up to $32,500 _per day_! The Sacketts have been dragged through the courts for years fighting for their property rights—**and yours**. Now, their case will be argued before the U.S. Supreme Court. And MSLF has lent them support in their fight against this blatant government overreach. That’s why I’m emailing you today with a special request. I’m hoping you will stand with the Sacketts and show them you support their fight by signing our petition today. If the EPA is allowed to trample the lives of private citizens like the Sacketts with no opposition, there’s no telling who could be next. But your voice today will push back against this injustice and show the government that you stand for freedom and the private property rights of every American citizen. **Please sign the petition below declaring your desire to stand against this blatant overreach by the EPA.**
* I am standing for the private property rights of Michael and Chantell Sackett.
* I am standing against unelected bureaucracies that threaten the rights of individual citizens.
* I am asking the U.S. Supreme Court to rule against the EPA’s blatant government overreach.

Please sign our petition right now at this secure link: **[https://mslegal.org/subscribe/sackett-petition/](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zla3t676s06s03m24ejc38v5e29ollr3de0okc78_rp22sh2s8i66or5cph64oj4cth2bs)** For Liberty! Cristen Wohlgemuth President & CEO Mountain States Legal Foundation

It transformed Tesla from the laughing-stock of the auto industry into the biggest car company in history. But according to _Bloomberg_ ... **[This new battery technology “could eat lithium’s lunch.”](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=a5dad9becf42482585c3af7e4b39f804&_e=p80iPCtUz3Ofb26u8291qQdy1qvW3EKBkL4hhsa-KsZekrV3KlKI5Mcw9VG0NBCkaFxkgpOYoJL4HeFBwNeE5c3UJKyJqRfzjVeda7Rhmuse34KFseEyNhzt6LOvAjEPPWjFwVq9vgNdPx5SDtW7U7qjjx0DV4Zs_rDwpGHWOSKR3fl-fc8reG8hefVo_13a2QghMH_UIzTLNp-z5Ii-aOHg4VUeDG2V2IZ3E1Cr6aAWa9iqFpODyQMmdlkf2sn4)** It’s a “breakthrough,” says the U.S. Department of Energy. Friend,

Would you believe me if I said that a mother watched videos of her daughter having sex with her boyfriend and picked which one her daughter looked best in to **sell?**

Because that's exactly what happened -- Kris Jenner watched AND hand-picked which sex tape her daughter Kim Kardashian would release!

**It is not an exaggeration to say that Hollywood is satanic.**

What could possibly be more satanic than a mother using her daughter's body to sell sex?

If that disgusts you, here's where it gets worse. _It worked_. Kim Kardashian is a billionaire, and she's still selling sex.

She is symbolic of the society we live in today. That if you are willing to degrade yourself, if you're willing to denigrate yourself, then our society will give you more.

**Is this the example we want to leave for our children?**

At BLEXIT, we believe families should be grounded in faith and honor and respect their children and protect their innocence.

My name is Candace Owens, co-founder of the BLEXIT Foundation. BLEXIT focuses on educating minorities about the history of our great country, the principles of the Constitution, and the importance of self-reliance.

I've set a goal to raise $50,000 by the end of the month to show the next generation that they don't have to be like the Kardashians to be successful.

[**Can you support this critical mission with a gift of $10, $25, or even $50? Click here to donate today >>>**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zhjhb8cdu2ag05733bupe244qd1srknncbld1ur0_rp22sh2s8i66or5cph62o33c1h2bs)

BLEXIT is bringing pro-America, pro-Family values to Black and minority communities through the work of our State Chapters.

Our Chapters spread the universal principles of the BLEXIT movement at the local level through community service, social engagement, educational activities, and virtual events.

They demonstrate how people can escape the mentality of victimhood and empower others to take control of their destinies.

Just this summer, **BLEXIT-Fest in New Jersey introduced our message to over 400 people.** They had a variety of talented performers and speakers and created a memorable community celebration.

**BLEXIT chapter members from our Tampa, FL, and North Charleston, SC sites educated and cared for approximately 80 children** for six weeks during our full-day Summer Camp.

The children in our Tampa program even took a field trip to Legoland!

Now that school has started, these BLEXIT chapters are providing an after-school youth education program - Liberation Camp - for 80 children.

_BLEXIT 's Chapters are a huge part of our Back to School initiative_.

The BLEXIT Illinois Chapter **distributed over 400 school supplies** and BLEXIT merchandise in one of Chicago's most impoverished communities. The NY Chapter was fortunate to **give away 120 school supply kits as well as 40 book bags.**

BLEXIT Chapters are changing the narrative that surrounds America's minority communities.

[**We currently have 42 chapters across the US and more than 14,000 volunteers! You can help BLEXIT support our State Chapters by donating $10, $25, $50, or any other amount today. Click here to send your gift >>>**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z4ni3ggevc7a57agemektqvsuuv4gigi80s2aorg_rp22sh2s8i66or5cph62o33c1h2bs)

BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence reinforced by groups that market themselves as serving the Black community, such as Black Lives Matter, but in actuality, they destroy communities.

These organizations are poisoning minority communities. They tell these bright young men and women they are victims of systematic repression and that their skin color is all that defines them.

But here's the ugly truth about other organizations who claim to serve the Black community:

* They claim to support Black communities. . . but they fan the flames of riots and violence that directly impact the lives of the people in those communities.

* They claim to fight for criminal justice reform. . . but they teach Black men and women to hate and disrespect police officers.

* They claim to be a non-profit group fighting for Black men and women. . . but they use donor funds to enrich themselves.

**These other organizations are destroying Black communities, dividing our country, and forcing a message of victimhood and hatred down the throats of minorities.**

BLEXIT is countering their hateful narrative, but we can't do it alone, Friend. Can you donate to BLEXIT today and help us reach our goal of raising $50,000?

| Dear Reader, This is troubling. Have you heard of [COP26?](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=7f0fde998ac4432fbc7f1fc4facab184&_e=bjHU0708qnGn9--nZqrzX2fHQm6C4mNksvuucOdLKzQjDz6PVgcb8uuqJHQ7JK7Ke6AieE6bmeIvoglz5A70rhQqQ-nh-LssL7ajZsWT9mV9rX6cVIaiAsGAlOxnSNZYp0pxIZpH1XbIF6Bf--kVIQTt5jQsYrTSpv04gj6MWi4de00towQJpzCBqTyZuun5_PkHWpqfmLlmbJ15tcmELWCdLjWQAsRihAtbXUnh8ns1CiJnk9jtngnl2DM--U0z) Almost nobody has. Amid the distractions caused by lingering health issues, conflicts overseas, shortages, and inflation... Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen recently took the stage at COP26 in Glasgow, Scotland to address some of the world’s most powerful people, including:
* U.S. President, Joe Biden...
* British Prime Minister, Boris Johnson...
* Canadian Prime Minister, Justin Trudeau...
* French President Emmanuel Macron...
* ... and many more...

From the stage, Yellen called for world leaders to commit to a $150 trillion ‘global transition’ of our economy. Since then, Bank of America has [signed this accord,](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=7f0fde998ac4432fbc7f1fc4facab184&_e=bjHU0708qnGn9--nZqrzX2fHQm6C4mNksvuucOdLKzQjDz6PVgcb8uuqJHQ7JK7Ke6AieE6bmeIvoglz5A70rhQqQ-nh-LssL7ajZsWT9mUpX6CSIGUYcqIJB9I099_JD9NHOFIThBahEu6I2zcJkPgV90ECy8tmVj7WA_hmEiDRxkuqBPTAce2oVRFtkCNyVSKT9TdGc0a-FEvATgzRH_t81zj6RfCzKYTboMGvZyJQ7hi2JbKKqSSr3NAxmE7H) along with 131 countries, 234 cities, and 695 of the world’s biggest companies. Jeff Bezos and Elon Musk have invested in this ‘transformation’ as well. What is it that Yellen, Biden, Trudeau, Bezos and Musk are pushing for? And what does it mean for your money? Investigative journalist and renowned economist, Nomi Prins has followed the money... [And what she’s found is startling. ](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=7f0fde998ac4432fbc7f1fc4facab184&_e=bjHU0708qnGn9--nZqrzX2fHQm6C4mNksvuucOdLKzQjDz6PVgcb8uuqJHQ7JK7Ke6AieE6bmeIvoglz5A70rhQqQ-nh-LssL7ajZsWT9mVTdW6l3IdAl08PURhR76T-hL4ABLHERjYbs-wc3b573zZx_O7G7KZFoefUNlQzW_04rj8WZQqWO3H9RCT1IiJWPYOXvWzi0k27J_EQByg2jwbiGW92DqDjgp4r1c4AQ0F1GBrsVlRn189lpd5q-0Ga) She says: **“While most Americans are distracted by mainstream media headlines calling for a stock market crash, I’ve found evidence that shows where the elites are spending $150 trillion to ‘transform’ the economy. Most Americans will be shocked when they see what happens next.”** I had to know more, so I scheduled an interview for Nomi to go deeper into the details of this ‘transformation.’ She agreed to do the interview on one condition: she wanted to record it so she could get her message in front of as many Americans as possible before it’s too late. [Go here to see how this ‘transformation’ will play out – and what it means for your money. ](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=7f0fde998ac4432fbc7f1fc4facab184&_e=bjHU0708qnGn9--nZqrzX2fHQm6C4mNksvuucOdLKzQjDz6PVgcb8uuqJHQ7JK7Ke6AieE6bmeIvoglz5A70rhQqQ-nh-LssL7ajZsWT9mWknNdYi4s4uDe4DxvBPMflHaJ4m1JsEoP036iFdnLWGHbCCO0hRTdZAg4bmWvLqDweAsY--Imj5gVuHNXLxG7KLpBlp-T4NfBMJILR09dG1cEeo6sA8cLciJxDgsaXy-FwBdeFsKMZLW6OpCqr6cLo) Regards, Maria Bonaventura

body:
| |
---
| | | Peter, my name is Adam Laxalt. You may have never heard of me, so I wanted to take a moment to tell you a bit about why I'm running for U.S. Senate in Nevada.

I was born in Reno, Nevada and raised by a single mother. Growing up, it was just me and my mom. I have always aspired to be as much of a leader as she was.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61563099:JE1eySVNW:m:1:3331421248:70AC15C57F8B14AB42269EE966295770:r "Adam 1")
---

I know that real leadership means standing up for what you believe in and standing up for people everywhere. But I was headed down the wrong path in life.

As a teenager, I suffered from addiction. But the people who loved me got me help. I turned my life around, and that taught me helping others gives life meaning. That's why I volunteered to serve in the Navy after 9/11 and volunteered to serve in the Iraq War.

---
| | | [SUPPORT ADAM LAXALT](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61563099:JE1eySVNW:m:1:3331421248:70AC15C57F8B14AB42269EE966295770:r "SUPPORT ADAM LAXALT")
---

Serving our country as a Navy Officer in Iraq was an honor.

While I was serving, my unit was in charge of over 20,000 detainees to keep American troops safe. This was one of the most challenging experiences of my life, but also the most rewarding.

_Knowing that I was on the front lines of protecting the country I love so dearly is something that I will continue to cherish for the rest of my life. _

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61563099:JE1eySVNW:m:1:3331421248:70AC15C57F8B14AB42269EE966295770:r "Adam 2")
---

After returning from Iraq, I felt the call to serve my state again and went on to be Nevada's Attorney General and top law enforcement officer. I fought hard to serve the people of Nevada, where I fought against President Obama by suing over federal overreach. I fought for the Constitution.

Now I'm taking on a huge challenge for our country: running for U.S. Senate.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61563099:JE1eySVNW:m:1:3331421248:70AC15C57F8B14AB42269EE966295770:r "Adam 3")
---

My race is **officially the #1 race in the country** , and all eyes are on me. The Democrats have already raised 76 MILLION to destroy my campaign.

Unlike my opponent, I rely on grassroots supporters like you to keep my campaign running.

I know I will be great leader for the people of Nevada, and for the people of America.

Now that you know my story, _**[will you please chip in to help me continue it into the halls of the United States Capitol?](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61563099:JE1eySVNW:m:1:3331421248:70AC15C57F8B14AB42269EE966295770:r "will you please chip in to help me continue it into the halls of the United States Capitol?")**_

---
| | | [STAND WITH ADAM LAXALT](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61563099:JE1eySVNW:m:1:3331421248:70AC15C57F8B14AB42269EE966295770:r "STAND WITH ADAM LAXALT")
---
| | | [DONATE TO ADAM'S CAMPAIGN](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61563099:JE1eySVNW:m:1:3331421248:70AC15C57F8B14AB42269EE966295770:r "DONATE TO ADAM’S CAMPAIGN")
---

Sincerely,
Adam Laxalt
_Republican candidate for U.S. Senate in Nevada_

---

My race here in Nevada has been upgraded to the #1**PICK-UP** opportunity for Republicans! This is the ONLY seat we need to win to flip the Senate **RED**! | | Peter, Are there any sane Democrats left who will call out Joe Biden for his insults? He is calling every conservative American a "semi-fascist." He's threatening to use the might of the federal government to murder Republicans. And not one member of the political establishment - including my opponent - will stand up to him. They always agree with everything Joe Biden says because everything he does keeps THEM in power. ENOUGH IS ENOUGH. It's time to fight back and make the government work FOR THE PEOPLE. Not against us!**__**_[**Are you with me?**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61554810:JP-MYSVNP:m:1:3334294963:C8CB2EA9AF71767B15959AD99E8F6D51:r)_**_ _**
---
[**SUPPORT KARI LAKE NOW >>**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61554810:JP-MYSVNP:m:1:3334294963:C8CB2EA9AF71767B15959AD99E8F6D51:r)
---
I'm telling you right now that I am a strong conservative who can get things done. I'm the transformative leadership we need. _But you don't need to just take my word for it. _ **I'm endorsed by:**
* * * * * * President Donald Trump
* Governor Ron DeSantis
* Rudy Giuliani
* Marjorie Taylor Green
* Sheriff Joe Arpaio
* Richard Grenell
* General Michael Flynn, and more...

---
[**JOIN PRESIDENT TRUMP: SUPPORT KARI LAKE >>**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61554810:JP-MYSVNP:m:1:3334294963:C8CB2EA9AF71767B15959AD99E8F6D51:r)
---
Together, we're going to unite to solve the problems America is facing right now. And trust me...there's a lot to do.
_But I know I can make it happen because I 've always been able to do anything I set my mind to. And that's not going to stop now!_
---
[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61554810:JP-MYSVNP:m:1:3334294963:C8CB2EA9AF71767B15959AD99E8F6D51:r)

---
I grew up in Iowa. There's not a lot to do there, but that's where I honed my work ethic. I worked hard. I learned to fight. I gained that fighting spirit the old establishment GOP never had -- that's what makes me a part of the NEW RIGHT. I developed that backbone of steel - that "BDE" that President Trump and Governor Ron DeSantis have. And frankly, that we want all of our elected leaders to have. Someone even recently told me "Kari, you're going to be the DeSantis of the West." Other than being called "Trump in a Dress" -- which is my favorite compliment of all -- that is the greatest compliment you could pay me. **To me, that means that you know when you elect me, you 're going to get someone who fights for you every single day. ** We are going to be so effective in Arizona.
---
[**SUPPORT KARI LAKE >>**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61554810:JP-MYSVNP:m:1:3334294963:C8CB2EA9AF71767B15959AD99E8F6D51:r)
---
**Peter, I promise you this, as the governor of Arizona, I will be the biggest pain in the ass Joe Biden 's ever experienced. ** I will unite with conservatives across the country to protect Arizona from this out-of-control federal government. We will save our states and return the power to WE, THE PEOPLE, where it belongs. **_This is our moment to make it happen. _**
---
Make no mistake... My opponent would be a NIGHTMARE to the pro-freedom, pro-America agenda we want to implement. Here's what you should know about Katie Hobbs. ➡️ **_SHE WILL NOT DEFEND YOUR RIGHT TO BEAR ARMS!_** Katie has an F grade when it comes to protecting our Second Amendment rights. I don't know about you, but I feel that our Second Amendment is the most important amendment right now. _It 's the reason that we are still free. _ **➡️ _HER VOTING RECORD IS SHOCKING!_** She'll never talk about it, but 90% of the time when she was in our state legislature, she voted against small businesses. 90 percent! **➡️ _SHE FAILED TO SECURE OUR ELECTIONS._** Hobbs served as Secretary of State in 2020 in one of the most corrupt elections in American history. **➡️ _SHE IS A CONVICTED RACIST!_** Two separate juries unanimously convicted her of racial discrimination, and the taxpayers of Arizona are paying for her crimes! Almost $3 million as a payout for her court settlement because she did not pay Black employees the same as she paid white employees. _That is disgusting._
We cannot afford to let a radical lefty like Katie Hobbs turn Arizona into another California.**__**_[**Will you help me defeat her?**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61554810:JP-MYSVNP:m:1:3334294963:C8CB2EA9AF71767B15959AD99E8F6D51:r)_
---
Now, I don't care if you're with the Democrat Party, the Independent Party, the Republican Party, the Pizza Party, or the Pool Party - our policies are going to help every American. **_[We have to stand together and defeat the left so we can save America](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61554810:JP-MYSVNP:m:1:3334294963:C8CB2EA9AF71767B15959AD99E8F6D51:r)_. ** I hope that you will chip in now to support my campaign for Governor of Arizona.**__**
---
[**SAVE AMERICA: SUPPORT KARI LAKE >>**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61554810:JP-MYSVNP:m:1:3334294963:C8CB2EA9AF71767B15959AD99E8F6D51:r)
---

| | | Peter,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

I knew when I announced my campaign for re-election that this would be a campaign unlike one I've ever seen before, and it has. The vitriol and slander I've seen so far this year has never been paralleled.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

No donation is too small. $5 makes a difference. $5 can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red.

I know our nation's brightest days are ahead of us, but getting there isn't going to be easy. _**[We can win in November if I can count on your support right now.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61559465:J0G-bSVuN:m:1:3360412034:463841ED1D9286DAB89B4426F4E2631C:r "Johnson1")**_

Please, Peter, our future is counting on our actions today.

Thanks for reading this email. I appreciate you and your family.

Thank you for your support,
Ron

subject: Proof that Hollywood is Satanic
body:
[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61563166:6hsRuSV5N:m:1:3331421248:F630EF09B791195478A8BA95D83866EE:r)
Peter,

Would you believe me if I said that a mother watched videos of her daughter having sex with her boyfriend and picked which one her daughter looked best in to **sell?**

Because that's exactly what happened -- Kris Jenner watched AND hand-picked which sex tape her daughter Kim Kardashian would release!

**It is not an exaggeration to say that Hollywood is satanic.**
What could possibly be more satanic than a mother using her daughter's body to sell sex?

If that disgusts you, here's where it gets worse. _It worked_. Kim Kardashian is a billionaire, and she's still selling sex.

She is symbolic of the society we live in today. That if you are willing to degrade yourself, if you're willing to denigrate yourself, then our society will give you more.

**Is this the example we want to leave for our children?**

At BLEXIT, we believe families should be grounded in faith and honor and respect their children and protect their innocence.

My name is Candace Owens, co-founder of the BLEXIT Foundation. BLEXIT focuses on educating minorities about the history of our great country, the principles of the Constitution, and the importance of self-reliance.

I've set a goal to raise $50,000 by the end of the month to show the next generation that they don't have to be like the Kardashians to be successful.

[**Can you support this critical mission with a gift of $25, $35, or even $50? Click here to donate today >>>**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61563166:6hsRuSV5N:m:1:3331421248:F630EF09B791195478A8BA95D83866EE:r)

BLEXIT is bringing pro-America, pro-Family values to Black and minority communities through the work of our State Chapters.

Our Chapters spread the universal principles of the BLEXIT movement at the local level through community service, social engagement, educational activities, and virtual events.

They demonstrate how people can escape the mentality of victimhood and empower others to take control of their destinies.

Just this summer, **BLEXIT-Fest in New Jersey introduced our message to over 400 people.** They had a variety of talented performers and speakers and created a memorable community celebration.

**BLEXIT chapter members from our Tampa, FL, and North Charleston, SC sites educated and cared for approximately 80 children** for six weeks during our full-day Summer Camp.

The children in our Tampa program even took a field trip to Legoland!

Now that school has started, these BLEXIT chapters are providing an after-school youth education program - Liberation Camp - for 80 children.

_BLEXIT 's Chapters are a huge part of our Back to School initiative_.

The BLEXIT Illinois Chapter **distributed over 400 school supplies** and BLEXIT merchandise in one of Chicago's most impoverished communities. The NY Chapter was fortunate to **give away 120 school supply kits as well as 40 book bags.**

BLEXIT Chapters are changing the narrative that surrounds America's minority communities.

[**We currently have 42 chapters across the US and more than 14,000 volunteers! You can help BLEXIT support our State Chapters by donating $25, $35, $50, or any other amount today. Click here to send your gift >>>**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61563166:6hsRuSV5N:m:1:3331421248:F630EF09B791195478A8BA95D83866EE:r)

BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence reinforced by groups that market themselves as serving the Black community, such as Black Lives Matter, but in actuality, they destroy communities.

These organizations are poisoning minority communities. They tell these bright young men and women they are victims of systematic repression and that their skin color is all that defines them.

But here's the ugly truth about other organizations who claim to serve the Black community:

* They claim to support Black communities. . . but they fan the flames of riots and violence that directly impact the lives of the people in those communities.

* They claim to fight for criminal justice reform. . . but they teach Black men and women to hate and disrespect police officers.

* They claim to be a non-profit group fighting for Black men and women. . . but they use donor funds to enrich themselves.

**These other organizations are destroying Black communities, dividing our country, and forcing a message of victimhood and hatred down the throats of minorities.**

BLEXIT is countering their hateful narrative, but we can't do it alone, Peter. Can you donate to BLEXIT today and help us reach our goal of raising $50,000?

name: Tiffany Smiley
subject: personal message for you
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Smiley for Washington, Inc
body:
| |
---
| | | Peter,

My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I'm running for the U.S. Senate in Washington.

I grew up in Pasco, Washington where I helped out on my family's farm and learned the value of hard work.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61563328:J41zuSVNt:m:1:3317145305:0BE75D0C6171F159A2A318B0C430FEEB:r "I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of
hard work.")
---

I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion of helping others in need.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61563328:J41zuSVNt:m:1:3317145305:0BE75D0C6171F159A2A318B0C430FEEB:r "I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College")
---

I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61563328:J41zuSVNt:m:1:3317145305:0BE75D0C6171F159A2A318B0C430FEEB:r "I married my high school sweetheart Scotty")
---

In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever, Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty's side.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61563328:J41zuSVNt:m:1:3317145305:0BE75D0C6171F159A2A318B0C430FEEB:r "Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq")
---

When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. They even asked me to sign a document, right there on the spot, consenting to Scotty's immediate discharge from the Army.
_**I refused. **_
Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61563328:J41zuSVNt:m:1:3317145305:0BE75D0C6171F159A2A318B0C430FEEB:r "Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and
every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.")
---

Scotty went on to serve as America's first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61563328:J41zuSVNt:m:1:3317145305:0BE75D0C6171F159A2A318B0C430FEEB:r "Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind
active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way. ")
---

It's not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way--_and won._

We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61563328:J41zuSVNt:m:1:3317145305:0BE75D0C6171F159A2A318B0C430FEEB:r "I will always stand up for our
heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.")
---

In 2007, we welcomed our first child. While Scotty will never be able to 'see' our children's faces, he's always been an incredible father and hero to our boys.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61563328:J41zuSVNt:m:1:3317145305:0BE75D0C6171F159A2A318B0C430FEEB:r "In 2007, we welcomed our first child.")
---

Now, our family is taking on a new challenge. I'm running for US Senate to help families across the country achieve the American Dream and save our country from Joe Biden and Patty Murray.

I will take the same fight and optimistic spirit I've shown throughout my life to help Washington families secure a better life. I believe that now, more than ever, Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61563328:J41zuSVNt:m:1:3317145305:0BE75D0C6171F159A2A318B0C430FEEB:r "Washingtonians need a voice to find
solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.")
---

My family began this journey in the halls of Walter Reed and we look forward to continuing this journey in the halls of the United States Capitol.

I would love for the next photo in this story to be us winning this race with my family by my side.

We can't do that, however, without your help, friend. _**[So please, can you chip in just a few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we've achieved so far.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61563328:J41zuSVNt:m:1:3317145305:0BE75D0C6171F159A2A318B0C430FEEB:r "So please, can you chip in just a
few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we’ve achieved so far. ")**_

---
| | | [KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61563328:J41zuSVNt:m:1:3317145305:0BE75D0C6171F159A2A318B0C430FEEB:r "KEEP
TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT")
---
| | | [STAND UP FOR AMERICA](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61563328:J41zuSVNt:m:1:3317145305:0BE75D0C6171F159A2A318B0C430FEEB:r "STAND UP FOR AMERICA")
---

I know with your support we can win this.

Sincerely,

Tiffany Smiley

---
| |

---
* * *
---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61563329:J41zuSVNt:m:1:3317145305:0BE75D0C6171F159A2A318B0C430FEEB:r "All Eyes On Washington")
---
Hey, it's Tiffany Smiley.

The Washington Senate race is now the #1 battleground race in the COUNTRY!

Needless to say, all eyes are on us. We are in the FINAL DAYS until the November election, and Patty Murray is flooding millions into our state.

We are in an uphill battle, and I can't make it up to the top without you. Not just Washingtonians, but all Americans deserve a real leader with real solutions. Together, we can ensure that the American Dream is not lost.

_**[Rush support now to be a part of history](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61563329:J41zuSVNt:m:1:3317145305:0BE75D0C6171F159A2A318B0C430FEEB:r "Rush support now to be a part of history")**_.

Let's raise money and WIN,

Tiffany Smiley

---
| | | [JOIN TEAM SMILEY](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61563329:J41zuSVNt:m:1:3317145305:0BE75D0C6171F159A2A318B0C430FEEB:r "JOIN TEAM SMILEY")
---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61563330:J41zuSVNt:m:1:3317145305:0BE75D0C6171F159A2A318B0C430FEEB:r "Alert!")
---

Team Smiley here with a RED ALERT!

You know we don't often beg, plead, or panic, but Tiffany is facing a key deadline, and we're OUT of time.

Whether or not you choose to act will decide the outcome of the Washington U.S. Senate Election:

Tiffany is currently being outraised and outspent by her 30-year incumbent opponent. We need all hands on deck to turn things around TODAY.

There's no time to wait on the sidelines.

_**[That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61563331:J41zuSVNt:m:1:3317145305:0BE75D0C6171F159A2A318B0C430FEEB:r "That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!")**_

This is our only chance to make history and restore a brighter future for Washington and all of America. We need Tiffany Smiley in the U.S. Senate, plain and simple.

Our team doesn't want to have to deliver bad news to Tiffany later today, so we're calling on our grassroots team, including YOU, to help increase our momentum!

Tiffany is a veterans' advocate and mother of 3! She is the new, fresh leadership we desperately need in Washington! Tiffany will be your #1 supporter in the U.S. Senate.

We're out of time. There's nowhere else to turn. Tiffany needs us at this moment. _**[Step up now!](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61563331:J41zuSVNt:m:1:3317145305:0BE75D0C6171F159A2A318B0C430FEEB:r "Step up
now!")**_

---

---

name: Mandela Barnes
subject: A Marquette poll shows me trailing Ron Johnson by 1 point
body:
Let me be clear:
Flipping Wisconsin's Senate seat this November is not a given. It's going to take an incredible amount of work to make it possible.
You can count on me to work as hard as possible to defeat Ron Johnson. But I cannot win this race alone.
I need you. A Marquette poll that came out recently shows me trailing by 1 point. Without you, we could lose.
So far more than 200,000 people have donated to this campaign. It means the world to me. But right now, I need you. And it’s not just me who needs you. All the people who have already donated, they need you, too. Because the only way we'll win is if we're in this together.

Thank you in advance for chipping in. Running for office, and especially a Senate seat against a Republican incumbent, isn’t easy. But the stakes make the challenge well worth it. Especially when we’re in it together.
Mandela

Have you heard of [COP26?](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=0859b2433cac474b96e4a9e13a336fe0&_e=SmdspBWUQ3WE3shU7HYwvaRbx7I8fe6jHo3Bbl8gxT2gh6gxVkxL0f2vlk1Gcj9qx5P8ro7jvLvQHP-62zQO6c_rUOKOdYZMPVKSAUJUnY8rRYmXq5NhlQ1ktxxsbjWVvXarXBsGRxjhZ0tV32nsRjDjpeDzXtWCJrMATdPOO-g9IZVSUq3KAMAKG8ASZjqB1F0E0Fdi8bKXjFd_fDfkB-NEWVuXq2C2aTgV4CPLFxh8tdoX1h94fP2mrNkTjTN1) Almost nobody has. Amid the distractions caused by lingering health issues, conflicts overseas, shortages, and inflation... Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen recently took the stage at COP26 in Glasgow, Scotland to address some of the world’s most powerful people, including:
* U.S. President, Joe Biden...
* British Prime Minister, Boris Johnson...
* Canadian Prime Minister, Justin Trudeau...
* French President Emmanuel Macron...
* ... and many more...

From the stage, Yellen called for world leaders to commit to a $150 trillion ‘global transition’ of our economy. Since then, Bank of America has [signed this accord,](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=0859b2433cac474b96e4a9e13a336fe0&_e=SmdspBWUQ3WE3shU7HYwvaRbx7I8fe6jHo3Bbl8gxT2gh6gxVkxL0f2vlk1Gcj9qx5P8ro7jvLvQHP-62zQO6c_rUOKOdYZMPVKSAUJUnY_ufs8UwOl7E4FmzxZMLhxetUAZvLMqeq1AqxZnMIcfzGwzEDedIbr1K52s1kEmEGpNvfg5a-XxOGwEgMGDahO8gPKmvm8hkf2tjokV5upTgrPnkijBAXY63TgSPfIg2_VtJLJzzODwTCRsz_QaxY3T) along with 131 countries, 234 cities, and 695 of the world’s biggest companies. Jeff Bezos and Elon Musk have invested in this ‘transformation’ as well. What is it that Yellen, Biden, Trudeau, Bezos and Musk are pushing for? And what does it mean for your money? Investigative journalist and renowned economist, Nomi Prins has followed the money... [And what she’s found is startling. ](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=0859b2433cac474b96e4a9e13a336fe0&_e=SmdspBWUQ3WE3shU7HYwvaRbx7I8fe6jHo3Bbl8gxT2gh6gxVkxL0f2vlk1Gcj9qx5P8ro7jvLvQHP-62zQO6c_rUOKOdYZMPVKSAUJUnY_B9I6a79CCe7ZJql9cm5ICtaj8rvOaT2-aNAL2YD_Plq4Ktkfe90U7WtDf4T1btsZ8pDChPXLmyOuVdVPvsM1y3FOCUVb9SwR1wiLLd6lqA7Ub8RxGP_uGNpTaevVbJ7gXhE5OwyDMNbI6cm4OBfdn) She says: **“While most Americans are distracted by mainstream media headlines calling for a stock market crash, I’ve found evidence that shows where the elites are spending $150 trillion to ‘transform’ the economy. Most Americans will be shocked when they see what happens next.”** I had to know more, so I scheduled an interview for Nomi to go deeper into the details of this ‘transformation.’ She agreed to do the interview on one condition: she wanted to record it so she could get her message in front of as many Americans as possible before it’s too late. [Go here to see how this ‘transformation’ will play out – and what it means for your money. ](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=0859b2433cac474b96e4a9e13a336fe0&_e=SmdspBWUQ3WE3shU7HYwvaRbx7I8fe6jHo3Bbl8gxT2gh6gxVkxL0f2vlk1Gcj9qx5P8ro7jvLvQHP-62zQO6c_rUOKOdYZMPVKSAUJUnY_Y_sYFKaVgZJLkmd6siaqVQtIUhBUBsE1GRycF5Dted45xv12NKaRZhMoMTts_oFwkEK6sv3GOV9DJmhqgclLKkKGdIyYPeFAID5znRVpTRuEH4E5B8b1PgEo7P0yp6zpbxedPad7qItttwwm_4pXL) Regards, Maria Bonaventura

Peter, I’m about to ask you to donate to my campaign – but first, let me explain why it’s especially important that you give today:
**We only have TWO DAYS before early voting begins in New Mexico.**

That means just *two days* to knock on thousands of doors and engage even more voters across the state with our people-powered message.
If we're going to keep the monumental progress we’ve made since 2018 – better access to health care, the right to safe abortions, tuition-free higher education, and more – we have to fight harder than ever to keep this seat blue.
**That's why I set a goal to raise $100,000 – which will allow my team to launch more ads and support the grassroots volunteers knocking on doors. If I fall short, I simply won’t stand a chance against my Trump-style, extremist opponent.**

name: Fred Guttenberg via Blue Amp Action
subject: My daughter was shot and killed in Parkland, four years ago. Since then, Republicans like Jenn Giroux have worked to end gun background check protections. State legislative candidates like Rachel Baker are our first defense against dangerous criminals buying all the guns they want, and your support can make a real difference in a race like this.
body:
State background checks are our first line of defense against gun violence.
| | | | |
---
| | |
---
| | |
---
| |
---
| | | | | Peter, in a moment, I'm going to ask you to join me in helping Rachel Baker defeat Jenn Giroux, in what is Ohio's most important state legislative race--perhaps one of the most important in the country. **_Four years ago, my daughter Jaime was murdered with an assault weapon in the Parkland massacre. Ever since, Republicans like Jenn Giroux have not only done almost nothing to solve a problem, but, in fact, they've passed legislation in Ohio and other states to allow any criminal or terrorist to carry concealed weapons of war in our streets, by eliminating background checks._** We've seen the results in Uvalde, Buffalo, Highland Park, and in 2019, the Oregon, District of Dayton, Ohio, when nine people out for a fun night on the town were murdered, and 17 others sent to local hospitals with their lives never to be the same. [**This is about saving lives: Will you donate $5, $10, $25 or whatever you can afford to elect Rachel Baker, defeat Jenn Giroux and put us closer to expanding gun safety and abortion rights in Ohio and nationally?**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Td41a13ce-d431-4122-99ce-ce15b408aec5/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) **After the awful Supreme Court decision overturning Roe v Wade, Giroux also came out against abortion in all cases--making the ridiculous claim that women never have to choose between their lives and having an abortion. Giroux's combination of extremism and ignorance are both astounding and dangerous. **
---
|
---
| | | | | | [**GIVE NOW >>**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tf6ee927b-6883-4464-8853-d3c6ccf690a8/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
| **Luckily, we have a fierce gun safety advocate and former Planned Parenthood employee in Rachel Baker running against her. And why is this so important? Because this district is listed as the most swing seat in Ohio, and if Rachel and four other Democrats win in slightly more Democratic districts, the Republican-gerrymandered supermajority in the state house will end. ** This is crucial, as Nan Whaley has a good chance of being Ohio's next Governor. even if the worst happens and Mike DeWine is reelected, on the few of things where DeWine isn't as crazy as the gerrymandered state house, they won't be able to override his veto. It is also key to getting closer to taking back the state house under the newer lines prescribed by a constitutional amendment to the state constitution. So I'm asking for your help, friend. Jenn Giroux is being supported by the worst right-wing mega-donors and interests spending a ton of money on her behalf. If we can help Rachel Baker overcome the right-wing money and win this race, we'll also helping turn out voters to help elect Whaley, and Democrats Greg Landsman in a swing House seat and Tim Ryan as our U.S. Senator. **_I've often said I consider Ohio a second home, as much of my family lives in the Cincinnati area. But, also, America is my home, and this race will have ripple effects across the country._** [**Please, friend, this is about saving lives: Will you donate $5, $10, $25 or whatever you can afford to elect Rachel Baker, defeat Jenn Giroux and put us closer to expanding gun safety and abortion rights in Ohio and nationally?**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Td51b1c8b-44b8-4dd2-b01d-c0368feb0c36/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

# Hi ,
Joe Banish of The Grand Forks Herald said, "Despite the event’s focus on reproductive rights, **Christiansen is far from a single-issue candidate** " in his coverage of the Reproductive Rights Rally in Grand Forks yesterday. He's right. As I campaign across the state, I’ve witnessed how access to **mental health** professionals is extremely sparse in rural North Dakota. **Of the state’s 53 counties, 24 do not have a single accredited mental health professional** , and nine of them only have one provider. **Rising teacher and nursing shortages** are impacting services especially in rural areas and **children in our rural school systems are lacking services** to help them thrive. But on Monday night, my opponent was a no show for the senatorial debate on BEK TV North Dakota. Maybe because he didn't want to admit that **he's failing the people** of North Dakota.
That’s why I’m running to replace him, **North Dakotans need someone who will show up for them**.
---
|
---
| (Photo courtesy of BEK TV North Dakota)
The **National Women’s Political Caucus** said, “we know you’ll continue to fight for us.” **They are right, I will keep fighting for North Dakotans.**
But we need your help so we can spread our message far and wide - this campaign is within firing range of taking this seat on November 8th.
**[Please chip in today](https://katrinaforussenate.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bb537a705e300eb5ec0192d9&id=81e7b8f809&e=101b417fd1) so we can keep up the fight and get our message out to all voters in North Dakota.**
Hope to see you on the trail!

Best,
Dr. Katrina Christiansen
Candidate for US Senate

P.S. [Read the full story](https://katrinaforussenate.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bb537a705e300eb5ec0192d9&id=ea8fdee962&e=101b417fd1) in the Grand Forks Herald.

_**This is disgraceful.**_

In case you missed it, the Seattle Seahawks sent a cease and desist letter to my campaign because my husband Scotty was wearing a jersey they gave him in one of my ads.

For those who don’t know, my husband Scotty Smiley lost his eyesight due to a car bomb while serving in Iraq. He then went on to become the first active-duty blind military officer in U.S. history.

A few years ago, the Seahawks Organization invited Scotty to be a special guest at one of their games and gave him this exact jersey during their “Salute to Service.”

---

---

Unsurprisingly, the Seattle Seahawks haven’t made the same threats when liberal candidates used their jerseys in political advertisements.

I knew jumping into politics would present some harmful attacks against me, but the Seattle Seahawks attacking my husband Scotty and demanding he take off the jersey they honored him with just makes me sick.

The NFL may use the mantra “Salute to Service,” _**but they clearly don’t practice what they preach.**_

I didn’t back down when federal bureaucrats were working against my efforts to help Scotty become the first blind active-duty Army officer.

So friend, I don’t plan on backing down to a woke sports team.

Friends -
We are pretty sure that when you woke up this morning, you didn’t immediately think today would be the day you made your first online contribution to Giffords PAC.

I wish I didn’t have to ask.
#

I am reaching out to ask you to make a donation to help us flip North Carolina’s open U.S. Senate seat, but first, I thought I owed it to you to personally explain why this race and your support are so important.
Nonpartisan analysts have said this will be one of the most competitive and most expensive races in the entire country. That’s because Senate Republicans know they have no path to the majority without North Carolina.
Winning this race means we expand the majority. It means I can cast the decisive 51st vote on voting rights, abortion rights, climate action and more. This is the kind of progress McConnell and his allies are desperate to stop, and the strength of our grassroots campaign has them extremely worried.
The truth is Ted Budd and his allies thought they could count on the nearly $20 million they’ve already spent on misleading attack ads to quickly take us down. But it didn’t work. We have fought back hard at every turn, and poll after poll continues to show us in a statistical tie.
But we cannot let up. It’s tough, but we have to make sure they cannot overwhelm us with dark money. I wish I didn’t have to ask, but I know that making the kind of progress our families deserve — building a future where each and every one of us can thrive — is worth it.

We must restore the joy of Christ to our churches and our communities.

We know that our strength comes from our obedience to God and our unflinching conviction in our faith.

Sadly, you'd be hard pressed to find such faith-based conviction in our nation's capital these days. Far too many people are motivated by personal gain, instead of serving a higher purpose.

| Peter,
This year's gubernatorial race in the state of Nevada is about more than just another election...
It's about holding the most corrupt Governor in our state's history accountable for the devastation he has caused families across the state.
Think of the communities that were disrupted when Sisolak shuttered places of worship, Peter. Think of the households that couldn't put food on the table because he shut down their family business FOR GOOD.
And through Sisolak's destruction, ONE business made out just fine... Northshore Labs, the company associated with one of his major campaign donors that got a nine-figure government contract for COVID tests that DIDN'T WORK.
Sisolak knew about it. He was silent until he got caught in a news investigation. Lives were put at risk.
And now he thinks he can take a victory lap, go on "Steve's Summer of Small Business Tour," and that we're just going to forgive him for putting LIVES on the line with his corruption?! No way.
We're holding Northshore Steve accountable this year. We're getting a proven law enforcement leader to clean up his mess in Sheriff Joe Lombardo. body:

#
**Just last week, Cook Political Report _downgraded_ their rating of our race against Dr. Oz from Lean Democrat to Toss Up. **
This race is getting closer every day — and we need a surge of grassroots donations to kick our campaign into overdrive + shift the momentum back to our side over these next 30 days.
**[Your support right now will make the biggest difference. Will you join the thousands of grassroots supporters powering our campaign by adding your first $5 donation today?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221009-2?amount=5&refcode=em20221009-7621&refcode2=7621_434096_Ttr0Kw&akid=7621%2E434096%2ETtr0Kw)**

name: Tyler Flanigan
subject: Help Needed ASAP - Allan Fung's Campaign
body:
Hi Peter!

I'm reaching out on behalf of Mayor Allan Fung's campaign for Congress. I noticed that you had previously signed up to volunteer on our website. I'm not sure if you saw last night's poll on WPRI 12, but we hold a _slight_ lead against our opponent. **That means we 're in a position to _win_**.

We are now ONE MONTH from Election Day. In a dead heat, this close to Election Day, **we need every single person who is able to contribute to the campaign in some way to do so ASAP**. Our opponent's volunteers are energized to take down Allan, spreading countless lies about his record and stance on the issues.

The only way to fight back is to spread the word on a grassroots level. There are TWO ways you can help ensure we send Allan to Congress. We strongly prefer that you assist us in Option #1, but we do offer a second option if you are physically unable. If you are willing to help us with either, please shoot me a response ASAP.

**#1** : _Door Knocking_ \- Canvassing targeted voters and neighborhoods on behalf of the campaign. We will train you on your script and how to use our door knocking app. You can knock any day, with Saturdays and Sundays strongly preferred.

**#2** : _Phone Banking_ \- Calling targeted voters on behalf of the campaign. We will train you on your script and how to use our calling website. You can call any day, with Wednesday nights strongly preferred.

We are in the homestretch. **Your help is needed. We can make history, but only if we do this together.** If you have any availability between now and Election Day, please reach out and we will get you set up ASAP. The worst thing we can do is reflect on what more we could have done after a close loss on Election night. Thank you for your continued support and I hope to hear from you soon.

Tyler Flanigan
Field Director
860-967-9155 (Cell)
[tflaniganri@gmail.com](mailto:tflaniganri@gmail.com)

Friend – I'd like to tell you a story about someone who's very special to me: my mom, Verlene Warnock.

As a teenager growing up in Waycross, Georgia, in the 1950s, my mom used to pick somebody else's cotton. She raised 12 boys and girls in public housing on the west side of Savannah – and although money was short, Mom's love was always long. She told us we could do anything we put our minds to.

**J****ust last year, Mom used her 82-year-old hands that used to pick somebody else's cotton to pick her son to be a United States senator from Georgia, the first Black senator in our state's history. God bless you, Mom. **
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52265590/371785682/-598064402?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk4378-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTEvMS85MDkwMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3ZTdjNTQ4Yy1mNDQ3LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=RWVuCPY6Xns4TJpA-L2gxARWHXhfaUfR8EO9N-Joufk=)
But my last race was just the beginning, friend. Right now, _NPR_ is calling me the most vulnerable Senate Democrat up for reelection, and GOP super PACs are launching ads to flip my seat and turn Georgia red.

**The only way I can fight back against GOP attacks, protect my Senate seat, and win our critical fights for justice is with your help. That's why I'm personally asking: **[**Will you donate $5 or more now to win in Georgia and defend our Democratic Senate majority? A grassroots contribution from you – right here, right now – will make what Mom and I never could have dreamed of a reality.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52265591/371785683/-598064402?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk4378-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTEvMS85MDkwMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3ZTdjNTQ4Yy1mNDQ3LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=RWVuCPY6Xns4TJpA-L2gxARWHXhfaUfR8EO9N-Joufk=)
My mom is so proud of what this team has accomplished, friend. So am I. Let's keep Georgia blue – together.
– Sen. Raphael Warnock

Fellow American,

When you look hard enough, you can find _anyone_ to say _anything_. That is exactly what _The New York Times_ has done in their most recent hit piece on me.

I've got to be honest with you, **reading their latest attempt at character assassination wasn't easy. I couldn't help but wonder, "are they ever going to write anything truthful about me?"**

_The New York Times_ tries to place the blame on me for racial clashes that took place in my hometown over 40 years ago when I was a senior in high school.

I'm not sure I can do _anything_ right in the eyes of the reporters at _The New York Times_. But maybe I should consider these attacks a sign that my message is breaking through. **After all, despite $50 million in false attack ads against me, the race between me and Senator Raphael Warnock is a TOSS-UP.**

[** HELP FIGHT THE LIBERAL MEDIA -> **](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=c6e1effb9d774bdfa7508bca01a7583e&_e=pPRej6DHHzAbJhuRQEdIv4N9gjA2DScTGwjXjuBdP_cRVzeyWuenQYAzYPXeWzMAIcI4szaQRtv_i2t2U7bMIHo32HTtRjv05-2vUiC37HaPdwIUyJMyNSyJLiHp8t93DPYjMRSOZFrfWsyobq7NXLaPTfvaWbUJi0SfIfR0FoowQq2x9nB_p1lqW5WlVpyi9VS2ztToQH3p970gxZFzG5jLnpmAgofQ0BUcB6WRFhm98OJItzufj6GymdXVzRKyA5J40lBbdtabp0pXnwhKKwvGGXAMdM4hCq6xZYRCR2y5zKU4BoKR2rt5Jsd2-LIZsgzipMM9MCVYTKr5wWQp8XTDBCkBt5Kc2Y_r3ohfZy62l_RJdB5K9Lny-llYyWIck8MM9YTkZrVNsoARgib0wl95jA28DLDOSKl2XIJnwTM%3D)
**[Will you contribute $6 today to make sure that nothing _The New York Times_ , MSNBC or CNN says about me in this final stretch of the campaign goes unanswered?](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=c6e1effb9d774bdfa7508bca01a7583e&_e=pPRej6DHHzAbJhuRQEdIv4N9gjA2DScTGwjXjuBdP_cRVzeyWuenQYAzYPXeWzMAIcI4szaQRtv_i2t2U7bMIHo32HTtRjv05-2vUiC37HaPdwIUyJMyNSyJLiHp8t93DPYjMRSOZFrfWsyobq7NXLaPTfvaWbUJi0SfIfR0FoowQq2x9nB_p1lqW5WlVpyi9VS2ztToQH3p970gxZFzG5jLnpmAgofQ0BUcB6WRFhm98OJItzufj6GymdXVzRKyA5J40lBbdtabp0pXnwhKK0rLwcxIUyiHsW3BfbWMdtKsiV1Cr18U_z9f0utG1t1OaKYQH0YAdJEMCb0Gm5F1BuGAWe9vHaBTmlv55AYvDTdtmhgK8uImcmE5LNQr3D8TL8FG8oyKq9EARVWMva1kjxGCJrAb5rr2u7S3oSDXLmk%3D)**

The Left is scared of another Black conservative serving in the United States Senate, so they're coming after me with everything they've got. In this campaign, the Left has called me a "white insult to black people," a "token...shucking and jiving for white handlers," and a "negro."

**Now _The New York Times_ suggests I am "not part of the Black community" because I "forgot where [I] came from."**

It's sad and pathetic.

**[I'm asking you to stand with me against the radical elites who want to destroy me personally and end my candidacy.](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=c6e1effb9d774bdfa7508bca01a7583e&_e=pPRej6DHHzAbJhuRQEdIv4N9gjA2DScTGwjXjuBdP_cRVzeyWuenQYAzYPXeWzMAIcI4szaQRtv_i2t2U7bMIHo32HTtRjv05-2vUiC37HaPdwIUyJMyNSyJLiHp8t93DPYjMRSOZFrfWsyobq7NXLaPTfvaWbUJi0SfIfR0FoowQq2x9nB_p1lqW5WlVpyi9VS2ztToQH3p970gxZFzG5jLnpmAgofQ0BUcB6WRFhm98OJItzufj6GymdXVzRKyA5J40lBbdtabp0pXnwhKK07KeUtDl3IDiRobdciLzBS5eveSi0PZOVB2LIt-krPl5YeG-eYEsaSsWTBiGfIRzjag_3qakx9yI7Lb3-97oswZodlA9BN93ki1eajiU4lgTEE5GaA9WYkym-leOaUR4V9Wq99L2VqzDVZURysAGsw%3D)** Fellow American, I need your help to fight back, win this critical Senate race, and get America back on the right track.

clean_body: I’m not sure I can do anything right in the eyes of the reporters at The New York Times. | Fellow American, When you look hard enough, you can find anyone to say anything. That is exactly what The New York Times has done in their most recent hit piece on me. I've got to be honest with you, reading their latest attempt at character assassination wasn't easy. I couldn't help but wonder, "are they ever going to write anything truthful about me?" The New York Times tries to place the blame on me for racial clashes that took place in my hometown over 40 years ago when I was a senior in high school. I'm not sure I can do anything right in the eyes of the reporters at The New York Times. But maybe I should consider these attacks a sign that my message is breaking through. After all, despite $50 million in false attack ads against me, the race between me and Senator Raphael Warnock is a TOSS-UP. The Left is scared of another Black conservative serving in the United States Senate, so they're coming after me with everything they've got. In this campaign, the Left has called me a "white insult to black people," a "token...shucking and jiving for white handlers," and a "negro." Now The New York Times suggests I am "not part of the Black community" because I "forgot where [I] came from." It's sad and pathetic. Fellow American, I need your help to fight back, win this critical Senate race, and get America back on the right track. I hope you'll stand with me. Thanks, Herschel Walker | | PAID FOR BY TEAM HERSCHEL, INC. Don't want to receive any more of our emails? We hate to see you go, but ._

Ever since my husband was blinded while serving in Iraq, my dreams have been on hold. I've moved across the country with three toddlers, taken care of my husband, challenged the establishment, and so much more.

However, these experiences have given me the strength to keep going when people doubt my ability to win in Washington. _**They don 't realize what I've had to fight for and discount my abilities just because I'm not a career politician.**_

But that's what makes this campaign so special. We're on the brink of a historic upset in Washington. We have a real chance to make a change. | **[**HELP ACHIEVE MY DREAM**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61563013:Ja-73SV_N:m:1:3253819041:774D3DB352A6D8FF12F864757B117275:r)**

subject: the fight of our lives
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Trudy Busch Valentine for Senate
body:
I understand that abortion can be genuinely lifesaving – but in the world I grew up in, it could also be deadly.
| | |
---
Peter – I was born in a time when abortion was illegal. **But no one has been born in a time when abortions didn't _happen_.**
Despite the intricate web of bans across America that had been spun over the decades before, thousands of women still sought abortions every year. But, instead of receiving the care they needed in an exam room, they were forced to turn to dangerous, unregulated procedures or self-administered efforts, often in moments of desperation. Safer abortions under the supervision of a doctor were limited to the wealthiest women who had the connections and resources required – but even they were forced into secrecy.
**As a nurse and a mother, I understand that abortion can be genuinely lifesaving – but in the world I grew up in, it could also be deadly.**
That's why Roe v. Wade was so transformative – it gave us all the freedom to safely and independently make choices about our futures, our bodies, and our health without interference or mandated bans from political leaders. It's impossible to count the number of lives saved by that single ruling.
For decades, I felt confident that my kids and my grandkids would grow up with more rights and freedoms than I did.** But now the dangerous, radical decision by this Supreme Court to overturn Roe v. Wade has s****et our country back decades, undermined the will of the American people, and put every single right that we care about at risk.**
**In the wake of this ruling, my opponent Eric Schmitt made Missouri the first state to enact a so-called "trigger ban."** Under this law, abortions at ANY stage of pregnancy are banned – and performing an abortion is a felony punishable by up to 15 years in prison. We're seeing laws like this pop up all across the country, and they're getting increasingly extreme. Far-right legislators here even tried to ban people leaving Missouri from getting an abortion elsewhere.
I refuse to sit idly by as I watch my state and my country go backward. That's why I'm working my heart out to defeat Eric Schmitt and stop him from taking his far-right ideology to the U.S. Senate. **You have my word on this: If you send me to Washington, I will proudly be _the_ vote that we need to codify abortion access into law once and for all.**
**[We're in the fight of our lives here, Peter. If you're willing to fight with me, will you make a $5 donation to help me flip Missouri blue and ensure that future generations have the freedom to choose?
