Please give me a chance to explain the two crucial moments that we’re facing in just a few days. | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52291741/371824922/871670916?refcode=AU_MFB_FR_GEN_MMG_AC_20221009_PM2_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjgvMS83NDc5MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxMGI2NmU0MC0yMTQ4LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=CkdDKNna9bghuQBwzlmC50NV_ofVNuiU3aosuWHhLlY=) Hi folks, I’m writing to you tonight to request a donation of $10 or $25 to support our campaign. Before I do, please give me a chance to explain the two crucial moments that we’re facing in just a few days. In eight days, voters across Colorado will begin receiving their mail-in ballots and casting the first votes in this election. **About 12% of voters are still undecided about who to support in this race, and we need to do all we can to put our message in front of those Coloradans as their ballots arrive.** Just before that, on Friday, we’ll face our final mid-month deadline of this race. That will be a major moment in this campaign — because it’s when my team will come together to decide what we can afford to do in the final three weeks of this race. If we beat our mid-month goal, we will be able to execute, or even expand, all our plans to get out the vote. If we fall short, our team may be forced to make tough decisions about where to cut ads, outreach, or organizing efforts. **I want to ensure we reach every single voter we can:[Please contribute $10, $25, or whatever you can spare to support my Get Out The Vote Fund. name: Alex Hess, LCV
subject: Make a difference every day of the year.
body:
The fight for clean air and water happens 24/7. |
---
|

| [](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/L6b_)
Every day, carbon emissions rise, corporate polluters destroy our natural resources, families are harmed by polluted air and water, and voting becomes harder for people of color. So every day, LCV is fighting for our climate and democracy and a healthier, more just world.

A group of special donors--**LCV Change Makers** -- helps LCV to **always** push back against corporate polluters...to **always** hold politicians accountable...to **always** mobilize volunteers for a national movement...to **always** fight for democracy. And we are **always** leading the biggest environmental and voting rights campaigns in the nation.

If you believe in our work to build a world where we clean up our air and water in communities hit hardest by pollution, safeguard public lands, curb climate change, and advance a more just and equitable democracy, then join us as our newest (monthly giving name) to keep our campaigns running strong around the clock.
|
---
[GIVE MONTHLY](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/6Lg6B~~)

**Here's a glimpse of what LCV Change Makers and recurring donations to LCV will helps us to do:**

* Put the U.S. on a path to cut climate pollution in half by 2030;
* Equitably transition our nation to a clean energy economy that will create good-paying, family-sustaining jobs;
* Pass pro-democracy bills to ensure that everyone has a voice in the decisions that shape our lives and futures; and,
* Direct at least 40% of federal investments to frontline communities, communities of color, and low-wealth communities who are disproportionately affected by the climate crisis and pollution.

Together, we can accomplish all this and so much more. Our work takes place every day, all year long. Help advance the progress we need to protect our health, democracy, and planet by starting your monthly gift today.

We can't wait to welcome you as our newest member of (monthly giving name). We're counting on you every step of the way.

Alex Hess
Director of Monthly Donors & Online Engagement, League of Conservation Voters

Friend,

Our country is getting worse by the day. Over time, the Left has destroyed everything we stand for and put America in a dangerous position.

President Biden and Speaker Pelosi have been implementing a Radical Agenda, leading our country astray and destroying the very foundations of American values. We must restore the America First Agenda that President Trump had worked so hard to establish.

In just 2 years, Biden has managed to divide the country more than ever before. He has called everyone who voted for President Trump extremists. We’re not the ones destroying families, we’re not the ones devaluing life, and we’re not the ones undermining hard-working Americans.

her up” in response to his rant about my work to keep our elections safe
and secure.

It’s not a surprise — I’ve faced nearly constant attacks from the
far-right, even death threats, and Kari Lake has called for my
imprisonment.

As a statewide leader who faced death threats and protestors outside my
home to defend Arizonans’ right to vote in 2020, Kari Lake and Trump’s
name-calling and conspiracy spreading tactics are honestly tiring. I
wasn’t afraid to stand up to these attacks in 2020, and you can be sure
I’m not afraid of them now.

I know Adam has faced many of the same attacks and threats from the far
right for his leadership during Trump’s impeachment and efforts over the
years to defend our democracy. That’s exactly why he requested that I
reach out to you before this weekend’s Trump rally with my opponent Kari
Lake. Our efforts are part of the same struggle — to defend our democracy
no matter what.

But this does mean that we need to be ready for anything coming our way
today. Our race is a toss-up, and we can’t let Trump’s attacks and lies

begins.

Katie

body:
[1]Stacey Abrams for Governor

It’s Lauren Groh-Wargo again, Stacey Abrams’ campaign manager.

What’s on my mind right now? It’s the fact that we have only 8 days left
before in-person votes start pouring in from every corner of Georgia.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/4397?refcode=sa_em_221009_B4_WakeUpCall_S1_T1_LGW_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1002&akid=11374%2E1862389%2EABpZ51 ]We don’t have a second to waste before then,
Derek. Thousands of voters
begin casting their ballots soon, and we need to be sure that there’s a
checkmark next to Stacey’s name when they do. So, will you invest
$5 — or whatever you can — in our campaign before midnight
to make sure we can spread our message, win in Early Vote and go into
Election Day strong?

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/4397?refcode=sa_em_221009_B4_WakeUpCall_S1_T1_LGW_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1003&akid=11374%2E1862389%2EABpZ51 ]DONATE

Since the very start of this campaign, I’ve told Stacey, our staff and
anyone who would listen that this campaign won’t be defined by negativity,
lies or the vicious lengths to which Brian Kemp will go to win this
election.

No, this campaign will instead be defined by Stacey’s vision.

A vision where health care, housing, education and a good living are
possible for all.

A vision that amplifies the voices of every community across Georgia.

A vision where no one is counted out.

But that vision is only possible if we put in the work to make it happen.

Right now is the moment to show Brian Kemp and Georgia that Stacey’s
momentum is through the roof.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/4397?refcode=sa_em_221009_B4_WakeUpCall_S1_T1_LGW_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1004&akid=11374%2E1862389%2EABpZ51 ]So Derek, in
these final days before Early Vote begins, will you chip in
$5 to get us through this final stretch? With your help, we
can show Brian Kemp, his allies and everyone else watching this race that
we have what it takes to get Stacey to the Governor’s Mansion in November.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/4397?refcode=sa_em_221009_B4_WakeUpCall_S1_T1_LGW_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1005&akid=11374%2E1862389%2EABpZ51 ]DONATE

We only have so many days left. Let’s make them count.

— Lauren Groh-Wargo

subject: This is my story
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Laxalt for Senate
body:
| |
---
| | | Peter, my name is Adam Laxalt. You may have never heard of me, so I wanted to take a moment to tell you a bit about why I'm running for U.S. Senate in Nevada.

I was born in Reno, Nevada and raised by a single mother. Growing up, it was just me and my mom. I have always aspired to be as much of a leader as she was.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61562931:6d97zSVNU:m:1:3253819041:DBCBA223B1B355AE8818E63638A27ADA:r "Adam 1")
---

I know that real leadership means standing up for what you believe in and standing up for people everywhere. But I was headed down the wrong path in life.

As a teenager, I suffered from addiction. But the people who loved me got me help. I turned my life around, and that taught me helping others gives life meaning. That's why I volunteered to serve in the Navy after 9/11 and volunteered to serve in the Iraq War.

---

Team –

I can't believe it's already October. The leaves are changing, the air is crisp, and Election Day is right around the corner.

One thing I love most about this time of year is going door to door and connecting with Granite Staters.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52293885/371844513/-947982778?amounts=3,10,25,50,100,250&refcode=mh-jtk1808-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjYTljYTNiMy0zMjQ4LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=PIbwd6xb4f-oYV4fEAuX_CIXLcqS7X0eGSmRAcAZ84M=)

That's what makes New Hampshire special: we listen to each other, we care about our neighbors, and we roll up our sleeves to work together to help our community.
**I know firsthand that organizing matters. In 2016, I won by only 1,017 votes – less than half a percentage point.**
If each and every person who helped by donating, knocking doors, or calling voters hadn’t done what they did for our campaign, I would have lost.

This year, with Roe v. Wade overturned and an anti-choice extremist as my opponent, the stakes are higher than ever before. That's why my team started earlier than ever to get staff on the ground, reach every Granite Stater, and build a winning campaign.

But now we have only 30 days left until Election Day, and we cannot afford to let up or leave anything to chance – not with the almost $60 million that Republicans are spending against me to win here and push their nationwide abortion ban into law.

clean_body: Protecting and expanding our congressional majorities must be a top priority. | | Derek: With a Democratic Congress fighting alongside Joe and Kamala, we’ve made historic progress for working people and families. We can’t stop that momentum now -- too much is at stake. That’s why protecting and expanding our congressional majorities is our top priority, especially as we approach Election Day. It doesn’t look like you’ve donated yet this year, so can I count on you to chip in $7 to help the DNC continue electing Democrats at all levels nationwide? We’ve already made tremendous progress together, but this November, some of Joe’s crucial partners in the House and Senate are on the ballot. If we want to keep making progress for families across this country, we have to make sure they win in November. We can’t do that without you. With only 30 days left, Democrats are entering the most important stretch of this campaign. We need to ensure these candidates at all levels of government have every necessary resource to win. Peter,

When you look hard enough, you can find _anyone_ to say _anything_. That is exactly what _The New York Times_ has done in their most recent hit piece on me.

I've got to be honest with you, **reading their latest attempt at character assassination wasn't easy. I couldn't help but wonder, "are they ever going to write anything truthful about me?"**

_The New York Times_ tries to place the blame on me for racial clashes that took place in my hometown over 40 years ago when I was a senior in high school.

I'm not sure I can do _anything_ right in the eyes of the reporters at _The New York Times_. But maybe I should consider these attacks a sign that my message is breaking through. **After all, despite $50 million in false attack ads against me, the race between me and Senator Raphael Warnock is a TOSS-UP.**

The Left is scared of another Black conservative serving in the United States Senate, so they're coming after me with everything they've got. In this campaign, the Left has called me a "white insult to black people," a "token...shucking and jiving for white handlers," and a "negro."

**Now _The New York Times_ suggests I am "not part of the Black community" because I "forgot where [I] came from."**

It's sad and pathetic.

**[I'm asking you to stand with me against the radical elites who want to destroy me personally and end my candidacy.](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=5852b8cc0eae4e87818c27c57d734dc1&_e=R7pP4armCqws0we27Atl_wPZTY39EPep1qY8a9N8sAc-xRNdSvGVLDgGNgSYzEfb7cXwq2SBurWjW22okwIBfD6lwv8h3GYrEYdpPhSgrYfRVEgtkpMtdc0YyJaNkBgpuV6_bDQu5UjbVUmKQJh150av3LTApTyoPO0GFp7xOY712iHlLOa2SGbHWl0nnrAGokLm7EBjRkRCVXsrPkuZTEOFvNNaOiBBkVEzjtBLzqti0VpKNsdn5q9VDFG9UUPMcJoVcRrSmAHB59RqdLQV0hYC9D6ZnIGh977s_mnoZ6GCtqJb3Pt4UNCfwMNdugzcx3aB4y1uS0DlnG43ph3e4Dy6EHOwQjkdKWhDQ-BMEonefykZGulksFiYKI9YBB5BZpbHSkZdrkFub34wiQ0tqYcUkGiJEVW51G7EeSwiNJA%3D)** Peter, I need your help to fight back, win this critical Senate race, and get America back on the right track.

clean_body: I’m not sure I can do anything right in the eyes of the reporters at The New York Times. | Peter, When you look hard enough, you can find anyone to say anything. That is exactly what The New York Times has done in their most recent hit piece on me. I've got to be honest with you, reading their latest attempt at character assassination wasn't easy. I couldn't help but wonder, "are they ever going to write anything truthful about me?" The New York Times tries to place the blame on me for racial clashes that took place in my hometown over 40 years ago when I was a senior in high school. I'm not sure I can do anything right in the eyes of the reporters at The New York Times. But maybe I should consider these attacks a sign that my message is breaking through. After all, despite $50 million in false attack ads against me, the race between me and Senator Raphael Warnock is a TOSS-UP. The Left is scared of another Black conservative serving in the United States Senate, so they're coming after me with everything they've got. In this campaign, the Left has called me a "white insult to black people," a "token...shucking and jiving for white handlers," and a "negro." Now The New York Times suggests I am "not part of the Black community" because I "forgot where [I] came from." It's sad and pathetic. Peter, I need your help to fight back, win this critical Senate race, and get America back on the right track. I hope you'll stand with me. Thanks, Herschel Walker | | PAID FOR BY TEAM HERSCHEL, INC. name: Candace Owens
subject: Proof that Hollywood is Satanic
body:
[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61562967:6Qaj9SVNd:m:1:3253819041:5CFA1718C0F482AD956DB2C33F7103E6:r)
Peter,

Would you believe me if I said that a mother watched videos of her daughter having sex with her boyfriend and picked which one her daughter looked best in to **sell?**

Because that's exactly what happened -- Kris Jenner watched AND hand-picked which sex tape her daughter Kim Kardashian would release!

**It is not an exaggeration to say that Hollywood is satanic.**
What could possibly be more satanic than a mother using her daughter's body to sell sex?

If that disgusts you, here's where it gets worse. _It worked_. Kim Kardashian is a billionaire, and she's still selling sex.

She is symbolic of the society we live in today. That if you are willing to degrade yourself, if you're willing to denigrate yourself, then our society will give you more.

**Is this the example we want to leave for our children?**

At BLEXIT, we believe families should be grounded in faith and honor and respect their children and protect their innocence.

My name is Candace Owens, co-founder of the BLEXIT Foundation. BLEXIT focuses on educating minorities about the history of our great country, the principles of the Constitution, and the importance of self-reliance.

I've set a goal to raise $50,000 by the end of the month to show the next generation that they don't have to be like the Kardashians to be successful.

[**Can you support this critical mission with a gift of $25, $35, or even $50? Click here to donate today >>>**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61562967:6Qaj9SVNd:m:1:3253819041:5CFA1718C0F482AD956DB2C33F7103E6:r)

BLEXIT is bringing pro-America, pro-Family values to Black and minority communities through the work of our State Chapters.

Our Chapters spread the universal principles of the BLEXIT movement at the local level through community service, social engagement, educational activities, and virtual events.

They demonstrate how people can escape the mentality of victimhood and empower others to take control of their destinies.

Just this summer, **BLEXIT-Fest in New Jersey introduced our message to over 400 people.** They had a variety of talented performers and speakers and created a memorable community celebration.

**BLEXIT chapter members from our Tampa, FL, and North Charleston, SC sites educated and cared for approximately 80 children** for six weeks during our full-day Summer Camp.

The children in our Tampa program even took a field trip to Legoland!

Now that school has started, these BLEXIT chapters are providing an after-school youth education program - Liberation Camp - for 80 children.

_BLEXIT 's Chapters are a huge part of our Back to School initiative_.

The BLEXIT Illinois Chapter **distributed over 400 school supplies** and BLEXIT merchandise in one of Chicago's most impoverished communities. The NY Chapter was fortunate to **give away 120 school supply kits as well as 40 book bags.**

BLEXIT Chapters are changing the narrative that surrounds America's minority communities.

[**We currently have 42 chapters across the US and more than 14,000 volunteers! You can help BLEXIT support our State Chapters by donating $25, $35, $50, or any other amount today. Click here to send your gift >>>**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61562967:6Qaj9SVNd:m:1:3253819041:5CFA1718C0F482AD956DB2C33F7103E6:r)

BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence reinforced by groups that market themselves as serving the Black community, such as Black Lives Matter, but in actuality, they destroy communities.

These organizations are poisoning minority communities. They tell these bright young men and women they are victims of systematic repression and that their skin color is all that defines them.

But here's the ugly truth about other organizations who claim to serve the Black community:

* They claim to support Black communities. . . but they fan the flames of riots and violence that directly impact the lives of the people in those communities.

* They claim to fight for criminal justice reform. . . but they teach Black men and women to hate and disrespect police officers.

* They claim to be a non-profit group fighting for Black men and women. . . but they use donor funds to enrich themselves.

**These other organizations are destroying Black communities, dividing our country, and forcing a message of victimhood and hatred down the throats of minorities.**

BLEXIT is countering their hateful narrative, but we can't do it alone, Peter. Can you donate to BLEXIT today and help us reach our goal of raising $50,000?

Friends, I want to take a minute to talk about what faith means to me. No matter what your religion or belief system, I believe faith is not about following some set of rules for your own personal gain or doing good for the sake of feeling good. And it’s certainly not about casting judgement, creating division, or spreading hate over our differences. For me, it’s about serving your community, leading with love, and lifting others up. My grandfather was the first Black minister in the history of the Dutch Reformed Church. He taught me to **have faith, not fear.** Those are words I live by and lead by. Through him, I saw firsthand how our faith communities are a force for creating a more just and righteous society. As governor, I will always partner with our faith leaders to accomplish that mission. With less than one month left until Election Day and a historic opportunity to make positive change for the people of Maryland, let us come together and have faith in our ability to meet this moment. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52290848/371821386/1144435635?refcode=nw_em_templateheader&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODM5MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3NzkzZTJmNi0xYTQ4LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=4onApzi2YkRSRxgOUwTmRgDG9543RnkcAqmmWm-vhzE=)

Team,

We’re just about one month out from Election Day, and the battle has never been tougher.
The latest polls show that we’ve caught up to Mike DeWine. And I know he’s scared. He’s afraid of this fight – too scared to defend his record of corruption and negligence in Ohio – that’s why he’s still refusing to debate me and why he’s enlisting dark money Republicans to pour millions of dollars into this election.
But me? I’ve never been afraid of a fight. Today, I’d like to ask you to **[chip in to our fight for an Ohio that works for all](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52290849/371821387/-480187799?refcode=nw_em_221009_2_t2&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&firstname=&lastname=&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODM5MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3NzkzZTJmNi0xYTQ4LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=4onApzi2YkRSRxgOUwTmRgDG9543RnkcAqmmWm-vhzE=)** – but first, I want to tell you a story about fighting back against those working to restrict reproductive freedom from back in my college days.
When I was a sophomore at the University of Dayton, I organized with the College Democrats.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52290850/371821388/-480187799?refcode=nw_em_221009_2_t2&amount=5&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&firstname=&lastname=&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODM5MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3NzkzZTJmNi0xYTQ4LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=4onApzi2YkRSRxgOUwTmRgDG9543RnkcAqmmWm-vhzE=)
We registered voters all across campus and organized in support of Democratic and pro-choice candidates.
We were at a Catholic institution, and we faced some folks who didn’t agree with us and went to extreme lengths to make that clear. One fellow student – who later ended up working in the Trump administration – even began following me around with picket signs and then unsuccessfully petitioned the university to get the College Democrats kicked off campus.
**[I didn’t let him intimidate me into giving up the fight – and I’m certainly not going to let Mike DeWine do so now. If you’re with me, donate $5 today>> ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52290851/371821389/-480187799?refcode=nw_em_221009_2_t2&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&firstname=&lastname=&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODM5MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3NzkzZTJmNi0xYTQ4LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=4onApzi2YkRSRxgOUwTmRgDG9543RnkcAqmmWm-vhzE=)**
I’ve been in tough battles before and won – because when we organize, we can change the world. Let’s do that again this year.
Onward,
Nan Whaley

Even though his values don’t align with the majority of WNC’s, he’s got millions of dollars behind him to reach voters with his toxic brand of politics. This race is winnable and you can feel the momentum growing. We felt it yesterday in Polk, Henderson, and Buncombe Counties as we were out knocking doors, and then at a rally in Brevard. clean_body: Let's keep our foot on the gas | Hey, We are just 30 days away from Election Day! Here 's the state of the race: We have strong momentum and grassroots support right now, but Cheri Beasley is gaining ground, and outside money is flooding North Carolina. Her campaign is majorly outraising us, and the polls reflect it. If we don't keep our foot on the gas, we will be in danger of falling behind. What 's on deck: Frankly, we're running out of time. This is the last month before the election, and Democrats are pulling out all the stops to flip this Senate seat BLUE and gain more control over the Senate. Why it matters: While Cheri Beasley and Joe Biden fight for their leftist friends, I'm fighting for you and all North Carolinians. I'm fighting for America First because they won't. So much is on the line, and we can't afford to lose. This is a 50/50 race, and we can't leave anything up to chance. subject: quick Sunday night message
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warnock for Georgia
body:
| | |

Friend, I needed to reach out with a quick update:
**Right now, polls show me neck and neck with Herschel Walker (R) **– which means we're well positioned to take the lead and win the race _FiveThirtyEight_ says will decide Senate control.

body:
[1]Charles Booker

Peter, it's late on a Sunday, so I'll be brief.

I’m running for Senate against Rand Paul because I believe Kentucky is
worth fighting for.

I grew up in one of Kentucky’s poorest zip codes. I’ve experienced
homelessness and have had to ration my insulin to help put food on the
table for my girls.

I’m fighting for Kentucky because the people of this Commonwealth are my
family -- and family is worth fighting for.

Rand Paul has failed us. He’s fighting to take away Social Security,
eliminate Medicaid, block funds for veterans, and make sure women can’t
decide what to do with their bodies.

I’m running because I believe Kentucky deserves better. And with less than
a month to go, I need your help. Can you pitch in $20 or more before
midnight to help me DEFEAT Rand Paul in November?
